type: ∀ {σ : Type u_1} (r : σ → ℕ) [Finite ↑(Function.support r)] (B : ℕ), (Roth.boxFamily r B).Finite
what: Integer multivariate polynomials whose coordinate degrees have finitely supported bounds and whose coefficients lie in [0,B] form a finite set, even for an infinite ambient variable type.
how: Rewrite by Roth.boxFamily_eq_image_finsupp_aux to the image of a finite coefficient-array box, then use Finset.finite_toSet and Set.Finite.image.
hypotheses: Only finitely many variable degree bounds are nonzero. No finiteness of the ambient variable type or positivity of B is required.
caller_summary: One explicit body call in Roth.exists_ne_modByMonic_eq supplies its local Fintype. No external-file callers; exact293 kernel audit confirms one direct value consumer and no direct type consumer.
mathlib_api_audit: Finset.finsupp, Finset.mem_finsupp_iff, Finset.finite_toSet and Set.Finite.image provide enumeration and image finiteness. Set.Finite.pi' and Set.Finite.of_injOn support a newly proved semantic theorem. The project representation helper is not existing mathlib.
moral_duplications: Shares the coefficient-array representation with Roth.ncard_boxFamily; finiteness and counting are different statements. It is not a duplicate of finite degree-index sets or nonzero bounded families.
generalization: Compiled: arbitrary CommSemiring R, arbitrary finite monomial support, and finite coefficient sets (only on selected monomials). Original recovered with no signature change. Also B=0 permits removal of the support condition; unqualified support removal fails for ℕ variables, r=1, B=1.
